description: A digital low frequency oscillator with a choice of five waveforms, giving 16 outputs at fixed phases around the cycle and four more at phases you set.

params.text: Sets the rate, 0.0039Hz to 64Hz, with a default of 0.5Hz.
Shifts the rate by up to three semitones either way, finely near the centre of its travel.
Picks the waveform every output carries: sine, triangle, sawtooth, square or rectified sine.
Sets the phase of that custom output, a whole cycle either way from the fixed phase.

inputs.text: Sets the rate, doubling it for every volt, added to the TUNE and FINE settings.
Shifts that custom output's phase, four tenths of a cycle per volt, added to its knob.

outputs.text: A copy of the waveform at that fixed phase of the cycle.
A copy of the waveform at the phase set for that custom output.

menu: Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
